description: Access skill for Ballotpedia political encyclopedia.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - person   Extract person infobox data including name, party, education, offices held, election history
  - office   Extract office/cabinet page data including lists of officeholders and their details
  - election   Extract election results tables from a Ballotpedia page
  - page   Get basic page metadata including title and section structure

url.description: URL of a Ballotpedia person page
